summary: Pipeline framework: declarative multi-step data pipelines with DAG ordering, typed parameter binding via ParamSpec, caching via PipelineStorage, and integration with the relation AST via PipelineStepRelNode + ParamsRelNode. Fluent builder: PipelineBuilder.step(...).build() -> PipelineSpec -> SimplePipelineRunner.run(). DBOS runner for durable execution. source() bridges pipeline outputs into the relation API.

key_classes.name: PipelineBuilder
key_classes.purpose: Immutable fluent builder — .step() returns new builder; .build() produces PipelineSpec

key_classes.name: PipelineSpec
key_classes.purpose: Frozen spec with topological_order(), parallel_layers(), ancestors() delegates

key_classes.name: SimplePipelineRunner
key_classes.purpose: Sequential executor with caching, empty-data policy, and topological ordering

key_classes.name: PipelineStepRelNode
key_classes.purpose: Relation AST leaf bridging pipelines into the visitor system

key_classes.name: ParamSpec
key_classes.purpose: Declares step parameters: name, type, required, default

key_functions.name: step(name, depends_on=...)
key_functions.purpose: Decorator creating StepDefinition metadata on a function

key_functions.name: source(step_name, pipeline=...)
key_functions.purpose: Creates a Relation from a pipeline step output

extension_points: PipelineExecutor protocol for custom execution backends
